question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Arrogant
solution: The correct answer is** "Humble."** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** __ • **"Arrogant"** means having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities. (अक्‍खड़, घमंडी, अभिमानी) • **Example**: *I found him **arrogant**__ and rude.* • The antonym of **"arrogant"** is **"humble."** • **"Humble"** means having a modest or low view of one's own importance or abilities. (विनम्र, विनीत; घमंडी नहीं) __ • **Example**: *He became very rich and famous but he always remained a very **humble**__ man.* • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2: Haughty** means arrogantly superior and disdainful. (घमंडी और स्‍वयं को दूसरों से बेहतर समझना; दंभी, उद्घत) • **Option 3: Superior **means higher in rank, status, or quality. (सामान्‍य या अन्‍य से श्रेष्‍ठ, अधिक उत्‍कृष्‍ट) • **Option 4: Scornful** means feeling or expressing contempt or derision. (तिरस्‍कारपूर्ण, अवज्ञापूर्ण) 3b:Tb1c, The correct answer is **"lit."**
